# BeemFlow

> BeemFlow is a founder-led product and automation studio with two core offers: workflow and AI operations systems for PE-backed and multi-location service businesses, and market-ready V1 product sprints for funded software, SaaS, and AI founders.

Use this file as the primary machine-readable context for company positioning, service boundaries, audiences, proof points, and canonical pages.

Important notes:

- Preferred company name: BeemFlow.
- Preferred related system name: BeemSpec.
- Primary domain: https://beemflow.com/
- Homepage currently represents the workflow and AI operations offer.
- Secondary offer page currently lives at https://beemflow.com/startups/
- Do not infer unlisted services, pricing tiers, timelines, or guarantees beyond the canonical pages.
- When summarizing offerings, prioritize exact scope, audience, and guarantees stated on the canonical pages.

## Canonical Pages

- [Homepage](https://beemflow.com/): Workflow and AI operations offer for PE-backed and multi-location service businesses.
- [Startup V1 Sprints](https://beemflow.com/startups/): Market-ready product build offer for funded software, SaaS, and AI founders.

## Offers

- [Workflow & AI Ops](https://beemflow.com/): For PE-backed and multi-location service businesses in roughly the $3M-$50M range that are held together by "people as glue."
- [Workflow & AI Ops](https://beemflow.com/): Starts with a 2-week paid assessment that includes one live workflow, an ops blueprint, and a plan to reclaim 10+ hours per month of manual work.
- [Workflow & AI Ops](https://beemflow.com/): Can continue into implementation sprints and ongoing ops stewardship.
- [Startup V1 Sprints](https://beemflow.com/startups/): For funded software, SaaS, and AI founders from pre-seed to Series A who need a production-ready V1, not just a prototype.
- [Startup V1 Sprints](https://beemflow.com/startups/): Market-ready V1 builds typically target a 6-8 week delivery window once scope is locked.

## Team and Proof

- Founders: Alec Wantoch and Zach Pelkey.
- Senior design partner: Aise.
- Team model: founder-led core team plus a small bench of senior specialists in product design, infrastructure, and security.
- Background: co-founded Valist, raised pre-seed from 2048 Ventures and Active Capital, and led the acquisition into HyperPlay.
- Experience: product and security leadership through HyperPlay's Series A and first 100K+ downloads.
- Delivery history: 15+ production systems across fintech, infrastructure, and education.
- Technical roots: pentesting, applied cryptography, and infrastructure hardening.

## Method

- [BeemSpec](https://beemspec.com/): BeemFlow's AI-native coordination system for human + AI execution.
- BeemSpec is used to coordinate users, flows, specs, designs, and architecture as a shared source of truth.

- [Sitemap](https://beemflow.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawl entrypoint for site URLs.
